prompt:
Use case: compositing.
Asset type: one TRANSPARENT character cutout for a very small fishing person in the existing miniature harbor animation.
Input1 is STYLE AND CAMERA REFERENCE ONLY. It must not appear in the output. Preserve its subdued pixel-painted lofi rendering, dusty blue/violet shadows and soft warm highlights. This person will be seated inside the little rowboat shown at the center-right of the lagoon, ultimately only about40 pixels high in the 1070px-wide world.
Generate ONLY ONE small adult human fisherman, seated in relaxed profile/three-quarter view facing RIGHT, seen from slightly above at the same camera as the referenced rowboat. Muted charcoal teal work jacket, plain tan trousers, small warm straw sunhat. Dark hair mostly hidden. No big face features. Compact natural anatomy, feet forward, knees bent, torso gently leaning forward. Both hands together forward at waist/chest height, gripping the handle of an invisible fishing rod that will be drawn and animated separately. Hands at right of body. Give the person a quiet unhurried posture. Keep arms connected and simple.
Only the seated person's complete silhouette, including hat, hands, legs and boots. No boat, bench/chair, background, water, fish, rod, line, fishing equipment, extra object, text or watermark. Actually transparent background (alpha). Do not use a checkerboard as painted background.
Style: restrained fine pixel-painted sprite with few readable blocky color clusters, broken soft stepped edges, not vector icon, not chibi, no thick black cartoon outlines, no photorealism, no glossy 3D. Crisp simple color shapes suitable for a small background figure; not a detailed portrait. Put the cutout upright near the center with a narrow transparent margin, not a large sprawling scene.
